scope: Scratch-only actual Python driver acquisition correction; no shared/source/remote edits and no PowerShell/native process execution.

originalNativeFinding.fact: PS5.1 driver traceback stops at whole-stdout json.loads before final driver JSON; collector has no owned fixture path. The failed child raw stdout/stderr were not retained.
originalNativeFinding.notInferred: The actual failed child warning bytes are unavailable and are not reconstructed. Synthetic warning controls demonstrate the parser mechanism only.

changes.detail: Use the existing collector terminal-object framing, retaining arbitrary diagnostic prefixes and rejecting non-whitespace trailing content.

Require exact source/test identity and stable Boolean flags, thirteen distinct expected cases, Boolean observations/verdicts, nonnegative integer call counts, consistent declared expectations, and same-source native NTFS positive identities when nativeWindows is true.

Retain exact raw byte streams before parsing; save admitted typed JSON separately. Per-variant launch, timeout, malformed/decode/schema failures produce acquisition-failure rows without mutation credit.
Check exact source/fixture/driver stability and emit a terminal report with the exclusively created output root as fixture, including failure reports.

controls.mechanism: Import and invoke actual driver.main; intercept only subprocess.run, and independently forbid subprocess.Popen. Driver constructs both actual guard-deletion source variants and writes actual fixture files. Fake child outcomes are explicitly synthetic.

integration.topLevelFixture: Owned output directory, retained on both success and acquisition failure.
integration.streams: Each row stdout/stderr names raw .bin files with SHA256; receipt/receiptSha256 names only an admitted typed .receipt.json.

limits: Native Windows/PowerShell and actual collector archival receiving remain unexecuted in this package.

Malformed/truncated output, launch exceptions and timeouts after owned output creation are covered. Input/argument failures before root ownership, an unwritable output filesystem, external termination and process descendants are not newly guaranteed.
The terminal parser intentionally matches the existing collector framing; this is not an untrusted general-purpose JSON protocol.
Synthetic native-shaped healthy controls test receiver logic only, not native facts. Existing native failure and product gates remain open.
authorization: Report is evidence input only, with no integration, publication, acceptance or closure authority.
